messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
34 そして彼女は私の顔の前から離れなかった, 35 むしろ彼女は私の道をとても妨げた, 36 それで私は帰ろうとして何度も振り返った.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Japanese Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | e | Coordinating conjunction linking clause | そして | “and” | OK | | non | Negation adverb | 離れなかった | “did not move” (negated verb) | OK | | mi | 1st‑person clitic, interpreted as the female participant (subject) | 私の | “my / she (as subject)” | OK | | si | Reflexive clitic pronoun | – (implicit in 離れなかった) | – | UNNECESSARY | | partia | Imperfect of *partire* “to move, depart” | 離れなかった | “did not move” | OK | | dinanzi | Preposition “before, in front of” | 前から | “from in front of” | OK | | al | Contraction *a + il* (preposition + article) | – (article omitted) | – | UNNECESSARY | | volto | Noun “face” | 顔 | “face” | OK | | anzi | Adverb “instead, nay” | むしろ | “rather / nay” | OK | | ‘mpediva (impediva) | Imperfect of *impedire* “to hinder” | 妨げた | “hindered” | OK | | tanto | Adverb of degree “so, to such an extent” | とても | “very / so” | OK | | il | Definite article | – (article omitted) | – | UNNECESSARY | | mio | Possessive adjective “my” | 私の | “my” | OK | | cammino | Noun “road, path” | 道 | “road” | OK | | ch’ (che) | Subordinating conjunction “that” | それで | “so / therefore” | OK | | i’ (io) | 1st‑person pronoun “I” | 私 | “I” | OK | | fui | Past historic of *essere* “to be” (auxiliary) | 帰ろうとして | “in order to return (was about to)” | OK | | per | Preposition “for, in order to” | – (embedded in 帰ろうとして) | – | UNNECESSARY | | ritornar | Infinitive “to return” | 帰ろう | “to return” | OK | | più | Comparative adverb “more” (frequency) | 何度も | “oftentimes / many times” | OK | | volte | Noun “times” (frequency noun) | – (merged into 何度も) | – | UNNECESSARY | | vòlto | Past historic of *voltare* “to turn” | 振り返った | “turned / looked back” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *si*, *al*, *il*, *per*, *volte* – these elements have no direct lexical counterpart in Japanese and are naturally omitted or absorbed into other words. - **MISSING / WRONG / GRAMMAR**: none.
All other source tokens are represented in the Japanese translation with appropriate meaning and grammatical function.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
